title: Chebyshev State-Space Compression: Provably Stable Near-Minimax Continuous Memory in Sub-Kilobyte SRAM for Real-Time Edge Microcontrollers
description: Technical report on Chebyshev-Compressor: an analytical orthogonal state-space model projecting sliding-window temporal dynamics onto shifted Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind (T_k^*). Features a Chebyshev-Gauss-Radau (CGR) Spectral-SAT boundary formulation with an analytical Summation-By-Parts Lyapunov dissipation stability certificate (A^T P + P A < 0), unconditional discrete Tustin unit-disk stability, Decoupled State-Space Readout (DSSR) fast-precomputed distillation, and an exportable malloc-free strict C99 engine requiring only 608 bytes active SRAM for 14 sensor channels.
